what: Eufymake states Amazon charges a flat 15% referral fee per sale, "much higher than Etsy's 6.5% transaction fee," though Amazon includes payment processing in that fee while Etsy charges payment processing separately. Amazon also has free unlimited listings vs. Etsy's $0.20 per listing.

While Amazon's fee includes payment processing, the total cost per sale is still significantly higher."
